high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "philosophicaloutlaws." The post features a black-and-white photograph of Carl Jung, a renowned psychologist and psychiatrist. The photo shows him wearing a suit and tie, with a serious expression on his face. The text overlay on the image reads: "Know all the theories. Master all the techniques. But as you touch a human soul be just another human soul." Below the quote, the name "Carl Jung" is displayed, attributing the quote to him. The Instagram handle "@philosophicaloutlaws" is also visible at the bottom of the image.
